headline: CGD's 158σ volume surge on CGD and CGD's pullback cap a PROP-heavy session dominated by thin liquidity and gap-driven moves.
market_take: Coverage saw broad-based weakness concentrated in PROP, with 7 of 15 top movers in the sector and sharp 5-day declines in A (-41.7%), GEL (-40.0%) and PRECHA (-17.9%). Liquidity was thin and erratic — CGD posted a 158σ volume spike alongside a -10.00% gap, and WIN registered 33.2σ on +10.34%. CONMAT was weak on the back of GEL and DCON; FOOD was mixed with AQUA, XBIO and CBG all triggering unusual-trading signals. Filings tied directly to today's movers — JCK's subsidiary acquisition/disposal, BRI's connected-transaction report and SEAFCO's new project update — provide material context for the RM follow-up.
